user.title: Select dashboards
user.description: Select dashboards whose combined entities will be sent to filtered accounts. Save automatically generated dashboards first.

targets.title: Select accounts
targets.description: Targeting affects every ordinary entity subscription using an account, including administrators, across all tabs and apps. After initial setup, reload pages that were already open.

error.no_accounts: Select at least one active account.
error.invalid_selection: Choose current, unique values from the available selections.
error.invalid_pattern: Use domains such as light and entity globs such as sensor.room_* without spaces or unmatched brackets.
error.not_loaded: Loona must be loaded before changing its filter control.

abort.already_configured: Only one Loona integration can be configured.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Every filtered account receives the combined entity scope of these dashboards.

targets.title: Select accounts
targets.description: Targeting affects every ordinary entity subscription using an account, including administrators, across all tabs and apps. After initial setup, reload pages that were already open.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Both Entity filtering and the Enabled switch must be on. Changes apply to existing subscriptions managed by Loona.

extra_entities.title: Extra entities
extra_entities.description: Include dependencies calculated by custom cards or needed by other sessions using a filtered account.

rules.title: Advanced entity rules
rules.description: Combine discovered dependencies and inclusions, then apply exclusions. Excluding card dependencies can break a dashboard. Loona controls and statistics always remain included.

error.no_accounts: Select at least one active account.
error.invalid_selection: Choose current, unique values from the available selections.
error.invalid_pattern: Use domains such as light and entity globs such as sensor.room_* without spaces or unmatched brackets.
error.not_loaded: Loona must be loaded before changing its filter control.

compatibility.title: Loona cannot safely apply entity filtering
compatibility.description: Check the Compatibility problem sensor, the supported Home Assistant versions, and other integrations that replace entity subscriptions. Loona preserves native handling when it cannot install its filter. Reload browser pages after reloading Loona.

scope.title: Loona is passing through full entity states
scope.description: Check selected dashboards and active accounts in Loona options. Save automatically generated dashboards. Runtime templates, dashboard strategies, unsupported auto-entities rules, or an empty scope prevent reliable filtering. Loona resumes filtering automatically after a complete scan. Download diagnostics for scan status.

exclusion.title: An exclusion removes a dashboard dependency
exclusion.description: Review Advanced entity rules in Loona options. Removing a referenced entity can break a card. Remove the exclusion or turn off Loona to restore its state.
